protocol.task: Main-clause subject/verb number agreement with an intervening prepositional-phrase distractor noun
protocol.surface_template: the SUBJECT near the DISTRACTOR VERB
protocol.target: grammatical iff subject_index modulo 2 equals verb_index
protocol.features: Concatenated role-specific one-hot tokens: 4 subject + 4 distractor + 2 verb. Input drive is twice the feature vector; no target-derived feature.
protocol.split: Hold out both verb forms for the four specified subject/distractor pairs (8 sentences); train on the other 24. Every token and both classes occur in each partition. Two held-out noun pairs agree in number and two conflict. Every subject/verb pairing has been seen with other distractors; the test checks novel distractor-combination invariance, not an unseen agreement rule. Never tune using held-out results.
protocol.batch: All 24 training sentences in fixed order per update, identical for all learning arms
protocol.projection: After each learned update, uniformly scale reciprocal hidden/output efficacy only if its effective incoming free/free row mass exceeds 1.5; both neural learning arms share this constraint. Input-source efficacies retain the same per-efficacy cap.
protocol.exact_baseline: Implicit derivative of converged same-network equilibrium by solving its free-state Jacobian transpose; multiply endpoint contributions by contact/gain factor. Apply the same efficacy preconditioner 1/contact_factor and the same clipping and projection as local updates. Loss convention is temperature times cross-entropy.
protocol.linear_baseline: Two-class affine logits on identical one-hot features, zero initialization, full-batch cross-entropy gradient, learning rate 1 for 8000 updates
protocol.gradient_audit: For every seed before learning, central finite differences of first/middle/last source efficacy, first/middle/last reciprocal physical efficacy pairs and three trainable biases (epsilon 1e-5), independent of implicit derivative. Also compare beta-halved local contrast with implicit derivative using contact factors and temperature convention.
protocol.acceptance: Every used free and detuned phase must have residual at most 1e-10; failures terminate that seed/arm and remain in receipt. Local signal must arise only from public Learner.contrast/update of actual equilibria. Report every arm/seed; no seed removal or update-budget extension after seeing evaluation.
protocol.evaluation: Initial/final train and final-only held-out cross-entropy and accuracy, wrong sentences, all phase residual maxima, total solve steps, parameter count, wall seconds, library/protocol/source digests. Local headline support requires all 5 seeds beat both frozen and linear held-out accuracy with at least 0.875 held-out accuracy, and the same-model exact baseline reaching that threshold in all 5 seeds. Otherwise report failure/inconclusive without retuning. Eight test sentences permit descriptive results only, not a broad statistical generalization claim.
protocol.scope: Small one-moment nonlinear finite-grammar judgment under supplied role coding and fixed architecture. No temporal-credit, word-token discovery, scale, biological, or superiority claim. Architecture and hyperparameters are declared experimental controls, not evolved results. Artifacts stay below 100 MB.

followup_provenance.rationale: Initial 800-update experiment missed robust criterion and retained substantial training error. This adaptive follow-up varies only training budget and fresh seeds; it is not an independently selected task or a relabeled confirmatory result. No further tuning or extension if it misses the criterion.
changes: Only training scores at initialization; held-out scores only after final update
